about: Picture brief for Ojo de Halcón (gameType 'look', docs/specs/ojo-de-halcon.md). Version 1 shipped with CSS drawings (public/css/look.css: the gold board, the LED wall, the lamps, the studio lights) + the art that already exists (Dubai skyline, saga avatars, cast stickers, Dralingo in his platform look, the saga falcon animation). Made 2026-10-13 without any image generator. Make these with the higgsfield-art skill in his Chrome (Nano Banana Pro, Unlimited ON) or the local AI studio. Originals -> assets-library/higgsfield/<date>/look/<slug>.png; stickers on GREEN are keyed to transparent WebP (video_tools keying, like the cast stickers); web copies -> public/assets/look/<slug>.webp (Pillow thumbnail 512 for stickers, 1600 wide for backdrops, WebP q82, each under 300 KB). Then swap the matching CSS drawing (the 'replaces' field) for the picture.
style: Premium glossy 3D animated movie style, cute toy-like characters and objects, rounded shapes, rich warm colours, TV game-show studio lighting (gold spotlights on a navy night studio), Dubai skyline lights. <SUBJECT> Centered, the whole subject visible with a little margin. <BG> background. Kid friendly. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no signs with writing, no brand names.
cast: Same character as the reference image: <WHO>. Glossy 3D cartoon render like a premium animated movie. <SCENE> Alone (the only person in the picture).
